plugins.name: @omdsh-plugins/omdsh-plughub
plugins.description: The omdsh plugin hub: a Settings tab that installs, disables and configures omdsh plugins from a configurable upstream, from the settings schema each already registers

summary: Install, disable, and configure omdsh plugins from inside Settings.
summary.zh: 在设置里安装、停用并配置 omdsh 插件。

plugins.name: @omdsh-plugins/omdsh-shortcuts
plugins.description: Bind a chord to anything the harness can do: a menu the desktop shell renders natively, a switchboard the runtime dispatches through, and an in-page listener for the web — one document, two surfaces

summary: One chord per command, on the desktop menu and in the page alike.
summary.zh: 为每个命令绑定一个快捷键，桌面菜单与网页端共用一份配置。

plugins.name: @omdsh-plugins/omdsh-document
plugins.description: Document attachments for the DeepSeek Harness web GUI: a Document row under an Attachments heading in the composer's plus menu, whole-window drag-and-drop and paste that turn Word, PowerPoint, Excel, PDF, Markdown and plain text into text the agent reads with the message

summary: Attach Word, PowerPoint, Excel, PDF and text files to a message; the agent reads their text.
summary.zh: 把 Word、PPT、Excel、PDF 和文本文件添加到消息里，模型直接读到它们的内容。

plugins.name: @omdsh-plugins/omdsh-vision
plugins.description: Sight for a text-only model: see_image, ask_image and watch_video tools plus a mirrored model route, shipping Qwen VL on DashScope, handing DeepSeek back what the vision model shows

summary: Let a text-only model read images and videos: Qwen VL as shipped, or a vision model you configure.
summary.zh: 让只能读文字的模型看懂图片和视频：出厂接 Qwen VL，也可以换成你配的视觉模型。

plugins.name: @omdsh-plugins/omdsh-remctrl
plugins.description: Remote control for the DeepSeek Harness: puts its own interface on a public address behind a passcode, over a cloudflared tunnel by default, so the window you reach from a phone is the window you left open

summary: Your dsh window, on a public address, behind a passcode.
summary.zh: 把你的 dsh 界面开放到公网地址，前面挡一道通行码。

plugins.name: @omdsh-plugins/omdsh-usage
plugins.description: API spend at a glance for the DeepSeek Harness web GUI: this conversation, this project, and the account balance, beside the mode chip in Chat and Work and in the corner in Code

summary: Session spend, project spend, and account balance, in the conversation's top row.
summary.zh: 在会话顶栏显示本次会话花费、本项目花费与账户余额。

plugins.name: @omdsh-plugins/omdsh-status
plugins.description: Current project and its git state at a glance for the DeepSeek Harness web GUI: the project name with its branch and change counts, in the Work window's conversation header, left of the Session log export button

summary: Project name and git branch with change counts, in the conversation header left of the Session log button.
summary.zh: 在会话顶栏的 Session log 按钮左边显示当前项目名称与 git 分支和变更计数。

plugins.name: @omdsh-plugins/omdsh-basemode
plugins.description: The session-mode system for the DeepSeek Harness web GUI: the segment registry every mode plugin registers into, the switch that renders them, and the sidebar dots that colour their conversations

summary: The switch every mode plugin registers into, and the sidebar dots that colour their conversations.
summary.zh: 所有模式插件共用的模式开关，以及按模式给侧栏会话上色的圆点。

plugins.name: @omdsh-plugins/omdsh-chatmode
plugins.description: Chat mode for the DeepSeek Harness web GUI: a Chat/Work switch above the conversation, and the managed Chat workspace its conversations are kept in, so a question that is not about a project does not need one

summary: Start a conversation without picking a project directory, kept together under Chat.
summary.zh: 不用选项目目录就能开始对话，这些对话统一放在侧栏的 Chat 下面。

plugins.name: @omdsh-plugins/omdsh-codemode
plugins.description: Code mode for the DeepSeek Harness web GUI: a third segment beside Chat and Work whose column is the harness's own terminal, running in the conversation's workspace

summary: A harness terminal in the conversation's workspace, beside Chat and Work.
summary.zh: 在对话所属的工作区里开一个 harness 终端，与 Chat、Work 并列。

plugins.name: @omdsh-plugins/omdsh-editor
plugins.description: Open the current project directory in a native editor from the DeepSeek Harness web GUI: the session header's editor picker, and the host half that finds the installed editors and launches one

summary: Open the conversation's directory in the editor, terminal, or file manager you actually use.
summary.zh: 用你真正在用的编辑器、终端或文件管理器打开当前会话的目录。

plugins.name: @omdsh-plugins/omdsh-sidechat
plugins.description: Summon a conversation of its own anywhere in the DeepSeek Harness web GUI: a side panel anchored to whatever you were looking at, asking in its own session so the conversation you are running is untouched

summary: Summon a conversation of its own anywhere, anchored to whatever you were looking at.
summary.zh: 在任何位置召唤一条独立的对话，带上你正看着的东西作为锚点。

plugins.name: @omdsh-plugins/omdsh-sidepanel
plugins.description: Work-mode side panels for the DeepSeek Harness web GUI: a right file explorer with previews and a bottom terminal, both absent in Chat mode

summary: A file tree down the right edge and a terminal along the bottom, in Work mode.
summary.zh: 右边一列文件树，下边一条终端，只在 Work 模式下出现。
